title: 第23章 秋院第24章 金乌神卷
lines: 山顶，原本的平地忽的再起一座新的院落。
乐临清与许平秋并肩立于院前，只见门口的牌匾上空空如也，似乎正等着它的主人赐名。
“嗯…你当初是怎么取名的？”作为取名困难户的许平秋当即问向乐临清。
乐临清臻首微侧，回想了片刻，方才答道：“因为我修行了金乌神卷，所以我取了金乌的乌字，叫作乌阁。”
“这样啊。”许平秋感觉乐临清的这个法子很不错。
于是他也也样学样，效仿了起来，从自己名字中取了一个字，将这间院落命名为秋院。
牌匾上旋即显露出了秋院二字，同时许平秋感觉到这院落和自己之间瞬间多出了一种联系感，似乎可以随意操控其发生变化。
这种感觉似乎和当初御使乐临清的飞剑差不多，许平秋暂时没有改动的想法，只是轻轻的推开了门户。
朱红的门户缓缓向两边收敛，迎面玄关便是一块雕着松竹景色的影壁。
绕过影壁，入目便是宽广大气的前院，种的什么许平秋不认识，反正他现在脑中只剩下一句牛逼。
穿过宽敞的风雨连廊，令许平秋有一种在逛公园的感觉，左侧有一湖泊，上有亭台水榭，水尤清澈，滟滟天光溶于水中。
路途中还有假山太湖石造景，迎客松，红颜枫，目不暇接，像是捻入天下春色藏于此中。
这一瞬间，许平秋感觉这软饭吃的可也太香了。
原以为自己要变成洞府居士，虽然住洞府没有什么不好的，但有院子，修行起来可以更加海阔天空嘛！
一路跟着乐临清进入了主屋，屋内很是宽敞透亮，并且窗户门扉都可推拉开，可看前院景观，左侧湖面水榭。
许平秋好奇的在屋内看来看去，绕了一圈后，才看见乐临清坐在了一张茶桌前，双手托腮，静静的沉思着。
在她的身后，门扉倒映着摇乱的竹影，叮咚的溪流潺潺声隐约流转，许平秋有些好奇的将房门拉开，只见后院还有一道别致的小溪，引动着泉水。
溪畔，翠竹丛生，绿意盎然。屋外的廊檐下，还挂着一串引水的雨水链铃，被微风拂过，便会发出一阵清脆悦耳的铃铛声响。
许平秋坐在了乐临清的对面，感受着清风拂面，顿时身心都随之放松了下来，只感觉悠然静谧。
与许平秋的放松不同，对面的乐临清紧锁着眉宇，眼眸望着面前桌上的棋盘出神，她正在思考幕语禾给她出的难题，如何教导许平秋。
“师姐在想什么呢？”许平秋看着她的眼眸，好奇的问道。
“当然是在想该怎么教你了。”乐临清望着许平秋，有些泄气的回答道。
“不急不急，想想当初师尊对你说了什么，你转述一遍就好。”许平秋伸手去揉了揉她的头，安慰道。
“嗯，但我要想想。”乐临清任由着许平秋摸头，又陷入了沉思之中。
看着她出神，许平秋不由闲的将目光落在了桌子上，桌上有着一副围棋，他将棋罐打开，有些好奇的拿起了一枚白棋。
棋子入手温润，有一种抚摸乐临清手的感觉，迎光而放，显得十分透亮。
content_en:
On the top of the mountain, a new courtyard suddenly appeared on the originally flat land.
Le Linqing and Xu Pingqiu stood side by side in front of the courtyard. The plaque at the door was empty, as if it was waiting for its owner to give a name.
"Hmm...how did you choose the name in the first place?" Xu Pingqiu, who had difficulty naming, immediately asked Xiang Le Linqing.
Le Linqing Zhen tilted his head slightly, thought for a moment, and then replied: "Because I practiced the Golden Crow Divine Scroll, I took the Chinese character for Golden Crow and called it Wu Ge."
"That's it." Xu Pingqiu felt that Le Linqing's method was very good.
So he also followed suit, took a word from his own name, and named this courtyard Qiu Yuan.
The word "Autumn Courtyard" was immediately revealed on the plaque. At the same time, Xu Pingqiu felt that there was an instant sense of connection between the courtyard and himself, as if he could control its changes at will.
This feeling seemed to be similar to the flying sword of the imperial envoy Le Linqing. Xu Pingqiu had no intention of changing it for the time being and just gently opened the door.
The vermilion door slowly converges to both sides, and facing the entrance is a screen wall carved with pine and bamboo scenes.
Walking around the screen wall, you can see the spacious and majestic front yard. Xu Pingqiu didn't know what was being planted. Anyway, there was only one awesome sentence left in his mind.
Walking through the spacious wind and rain corridor, Xu Pingqiu felt like he was walking in a park. There was a lake on the left with pavilions and water pavilions. The water was particularly clear, and the skylight was dissolved in the water.
Along the way, there are also rockeries, Taihu stone landscaping, welcoming pines, and red maples, which are dazzling to the eye, as if the spring scenery is twisted into the world and hidden in it.
At this moment, Xu Pingqiu felt that this soft rice was too delicious.
I originally thought that I was going to become a layman in a cave. Although there is nothing wrong with living in a cave, with a yard, the world and the sky can be broadened during practice!
Following Le Linqing all the way into the main house, the house is very spacious and bright, and the windows and doors can be pushed open to see the view of the front yard and the lake on the left.
Xu Pingqiu looked around the room curiously. After walking around, he saw Le Linqing sitting at a tea table, holding his chin in his hands, thinking quietly.
Behind her, the door reflected the swaying bamboo shadows, and the gurgling sound of the stream was faintly flowing. Xu Pingqiu opened the door curiously, and saw a unique stream in the backyard, leading to spring water.
Along the stream, there are thick green bamboos and lush greenery. Under the eaves outside the house, there is also a string of rain chain bells that divert water. When the breeze blows, they will make a crisp and sweet sound.
Xu Pingqiu sat opposite Le Linqing, feeling the breeze blowing on his face. His body and mind immediately relaxed, and he just felt leisurely and quiet.
Different from Xu Pingqiu's relaxation, Le Linqing opposite her frowned and stared at the chessboard on the table in front of her. She was thinking about the difficult problem Mu Yuhe had given her and how to teach Xu Pingqiu.
"What is Senior Sister thinking about?" Xu Pingqiu looked into her eyes and asked curiously.
"Of course I'm thinking about how to teach you." Le Linqing looked at Xu Pingqiu and replied somewhat discouraged.
"Don't be hasty, don't be hasty, just think about what Master said to you, and just repeat it." Xu Pingqiu reached out and rubbed her head, comforting her.
"Yeah, but I have to think about it." Le Linqing let Xu Pingqiu touch his head and fell into deep thought again.
Seeing her lost in thought, Xu Pingqiu couldn't help but cast his eyes on the table. There was a set of Go on the table. He opened the chess can and picked up a white chess piece out of curiosity.
The chess piece is warm and moist in the hand, and it feels like stroking Le Linqing's hand. When exposed to the light, it looks very translucent.
